about: Web ⇄ app parity manifest (docs/design/web-planner.md §14). mirrors = app logic the web re-implements in TS: CI fails when the app file changed since the mirror was last checked. shared = every file the engine compiles as it is (the :core folder minus the stand-ins in web/engine/src/main/kotlin and web/engine/core-excludes.txt, the app files in app/web-shared-files.txt, its tests, strings, BRouter jars and profiles): changes reach the web by merging main; listed as warnings, perf- / memory-relevant lines called out. watch = app files with plan behaviour the web neither compiles nor mirrors: changes are listed. After checking a change: node web/parity/check.mjs --update (or --update <app path> …).
